lesson.title: Exchange names with a friend
lesson.scenario: A mutual friend has explicitly invited Alex and Camille to use tu with each other.
lesson.unitTitle: Meet someone and keep the exchange going

introduction.goal: Give an assigned name, ask a name and return the question.
introduction.usageNote: Use the fictional assigned name. Tu and toi belong to this explicitly familiar exchange; they are not universal defaults for every person you meet.
introduction.dialectNote: Reference target: contemporary everyday Metropolitan French. Familiar tu and polite singular vous are explicitly assigned by scene, not inferred from age or appearance. No regional alternative is claimed without a reviewed source.
